# AftermathFi's Perpetuals V2 launches on mainnet after 12-week security review clears all major issues AftermathFi is bringing its Perpetuals V2 to mainnet on August 18, and for once, the security story behind a DeFi launch is actually worth reading\. Blockchain security firm OtterSec spent 12 weeks combing through nine separate repositories of the protocol’s smart contracts and came up empty on critical and high-severity issues, a result that matters considerably more given what happened the last time AftermathFi ran a perpetuals product in production\. # GameStop’s Zelda Ocarina of Time Pre-Order “Leak” Looks Like an Error Share this article Nintendo has confirmed The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 in 2026, but it has not announced an official release date or pre-order schedule\. \(Nintendo\) **Nintendo** officially announced **The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time** for **Switch 2** in June, but it has not yet revealed the game’s release date, price, or pre-order schedule\. That lack of information recently turned what appears to be a retailer error into a widely shared Zelda “leak\.” A GameStop search result reportedly displayed an August 4, 2026 date alongside the upcoming Ocarina of Time release\. Some fans interpreted the date as the start of pre-orders or even a possible launch date\. However, the available evidence suggests that the date probably did not belong to Zelda at all\. ## The August 4 Date Likely Came From Another Game August 4, 2026 is the confirmed release date for Beast of Reincarnation, an upcoming action RPG from Game Freak\. GameStop already has active product pages and pre-order information for the game\. This makes a retailer database or search indexing error the most plausible explanation\.
